mv-tt0178657.s: Jeca Tatu is a lazy, simple-minded guy who has his property threatened by the greed of a landowner.

tv-tt27540960.s: Jai Mahendran is an Indian Malayalam-language drama streaming television series directed by Srikanth Mohan and written by Rahul Riji Nair. mv-tt0077556.s: Fists of Bruce Lee (Chinese: 伏擊) is a 1979 Bruceploitation film starring Bruce Lee imitator, Bruce Li. Co-directed by Li and Kim Hyung-Joon, the film was released in Hong Kong on April 17, 1979.

mv-tt0791225.s: Cardiofitness is a 2007 romantic comedy film directed by Fabio Tagliavia and starring Nicoletta Romanoff. It is based on a novel with the same name by Alessandra Montrucchio.

tv-tt1152802.s: Cock'd Gunns is a Canadian English language mockumentary television series originally produced for IFC and later broadcast on Showcase. The series documents the lives of members of the fictional rock band Cock'd Gunns, as they try to become the biggest band in the world.

tv-tt8583412.s: Monologues inspired by women who have spoken out, challenged the status quo or made a stand – often at great personal cost.

mv-tt0045656.s: Crazylegs is a 1953 film about Elroy Hirsch's football career. tv-tt11101504.s: The story of Sayed (Fahmy), who comes from a poor background and marries a well-off woman, and gets in trouble when a family member cons a sum of money and involves him unwillingly.

tv-tt13142378.s: McGraw Ave is a drama series which is set in one of the most notorious neighborhoods in the heart of Detroit. tv-tt38755328.s: ‌Beretta; The Story Of A Gun (Persian: بِرِتا؛ داستان یک اسلحه) is an Iranian television series created by Amir Hossein Torabi for Filmnet. It stars Shahram Haghighat Doost as the lead character, with Mehraveh Sharifinia.

mv-tt0069416.s: Trzeba zabić tę miłość is a 1972 film directed by Janusz Morgenstern and written by Janusz Głowacki.
